_comment: Hand-written oracle for the fictional checkout-api exporter upgrade in this directory. Each query is labelled from what the upgrade does to the series it reads, independently of otelwrench output.

p95 latency by route.why: reads http_server_duration_bucket, renamed with a _milliseconds suffix

Orders per minute.why: reads checkout_orders, renamed with a _total suffix

Payment responses by status.why: groups by status_code, renamed to http_response_status_code

Outbound requests by peer.why: family and the peer label are unchanged

Worker job starts.why: rate() over worker_jobs_active, now a gauge

Inventory RPCs by method.why: sum by (rpc_method) still works; the new port label only adds series

CheckoutLatencyHigh.why: reads http_server_duration_bucket; the alert can never fire

QueueBacklog.why: reads queue_wait_milliseconds; the new series is in seconds, so a renamed query also needs 0.5 instead of 500
